# Chrome Web Store

> > Official marketplace for Chrome browser extensions, themes, and add-ons that enhance browsing functionality and productivity.

The Chrome Web Store serves as Google's central distribution platform for Chrome browser extensions and themes. It features thousands of tools ranging from AI-powered assistants and productivity enhancers to ad blockers, VPNs, and specialized utilities for platforms like YouTube and gaming.

## Key Topics

- Chrome browser extensions
- Browser themes and customization
- AI-powered extensions
- Productivity tools
- Ad blocking and privacy
- YouTube enhancements
- VPN services
- Developer tools
- Gaming utilities
- Content automation
- Browser add-ons
- Extension marketplace
- Chrome Web Store API

## Main

- [Chrome Web Store](https://chromewebstore.google.com/): Chrome Web Store homepage for browser extensions, themes, and add-ons
